map.物料平衡：总投入 − 总产出 = 损耗（含水蒸发、剔废、粘壁等）。得率 = 总产: Material balance: total input − total output = loss (water evaporation, rejects, wall sticking and so on). Yield = total output ÷ total input × 100%. A sound process gives a stable yield with explainable losses; abnormal yield swings point to process or metering problems.
map.得率 = 总产出 ÷ 总投入 ×100%；损耗量 = 总投入 − 总产出；损耗率: Yield = total output ÷ total input × 100%; loss amount = total input − total output; loss rate = loss ÷ total input × 100%.
